description: Lists keywords the competitors rank for in one market that the user's domain does not, or ranks far below them for. Use it to find content the site is missing. It spends from the user's own DataForSEO account inside the extension, within the monthly cap set there; a call over the cap is refused with an error saying so, and a cached answer from the last 7 days costs nothing. The agent never sees the key. Returns rows of keyword, volume, the user's position (null when it does not rank) and each competitor's position.

competitors.description: Competitor domains without a scheme, such as ["rival.com", "other.example"]; 1 to 10.

domain.description: The user's domain without a scheme, such as "acme.example".

limit.description: The most keywords to return, 1 to 1000. Defaults to 100.

location.description: The market to read, as a country name DataForSEO knows, such as "United States" or "United Kingdom". Defaults to the market set in the extension.

name: keyword_gap
title: Keyword gap
